scores.note: 2 reverses the paragraph's point (stereotypes hide how alike the groups are, not 'real differences') and 'he' has no antecedent. 1 'by their group stereotype' is awkward, a near copy of the last sentence. 3 'his stereotype about' is slightly off usage. 4 'proves' overstates and Randy's point is the fighting, not having problems. 5 is the clear best but sits last.
